fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Open Lawn Area; Access Drive; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation; Open Terrain
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles so emergency apparatus can reach the residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear sightlines and overhead clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Mark or unlock any gate controlling access to the rear of the property so responders can reach that area without delay.
• Clear a path through dense vegetation between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings on foot.
• Keep the open lawn area free of stored equipment or materials so it can be used as a staging area for apparatus or personnel.
• Thin dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can work around all sides of the building.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Irrigated Landscape; Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Shrubs; Single Access Route; Limited Rear Access; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Ground Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly against or touching the exterior walls of the structure.
• Thin the vegetation surrounding the structure to create open gaps between plant groupings.
• Remove any dead or dry ground vegetation that has accumulated close to the structure.
• Keep shrubs near the structure low and separated from each other rather than growing together in continuous patches.
• Clear overhanging branches or shrubs that crowd the single access route into the property.
• Keep the driveway edges trimmed back so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Remove shrubs or ground vegetation that blocks sightlines along the driveway approach.
• Clear a turning or staging area near the structure so vehicles are not forced to back out along the single access route.
• Trim back vegetation along the rear of the structure to allow movement around all sides.
• Remove ground vegetation that has grown up against fencing, outbuildings, or other structures on the property.
• Keep irrigated plantings close to the structure low-growing and spaced apart rather than in dense groupings.
• Move any stored materials, firewood, or debris away from the exterior walls of the structure.
